custom_css: @media screen and (max-width: 989px) {.header {display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2px 15px; } .header__heading, .header__heading-link {margin: 0; text-align: left; justify-self: start; } .header__icon--account {display: none; } .header__icons {margin-left: auto; padding-right: 0; }}
